effects.lua_implementation: Uncopyable, cannot-disable CANNOT_SUMMON and CANNOT_MSET single effects.

effects.printed_clause: If opponent Normal/Special Summons: Special Summon this from hand, then optionally add Level 1 Aqua except itself; it cannot activate effects this turn. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Opponent Normal/Special event triggers share HOPT; summons handler, optionally searches, then installs phase-only CANNOT_TRIGGER on the selected card so it follows zones through the turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Hand trigger on another player's Special Summon and self Special Summon.
Temporary CANNOT_TRIGGER restriction on a selected monster.

coverage_override.reason: The Normal Summon/Set prohibition is one procedure restriction and the opponent-Summon self-Summon/optional search/temporary effect lock plus HOPT is one activated effect.
